The Prophet took his companions' pledge not to associate partners with Allah, steal, commit illegal intercourse, kill their children, slander or disobey in good, worldly punishment expiating such a sin.
Jarir pledged allegiance to the Prophet to testify that none is worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is His Apostle, pray, pay zakat, listen and obey, and advise every Muslim well.
Heraclius called keeping promises and trusts a prophet's quality, a hypocrite breaks promises, Abu Bakr paid what the Prophet promised Jabir, and Moses completed the longer term.
The Prophet took believing women's pledge of allegiance by words alone, never touching a woman's hand, and men pledged to pray, pay zakat and give good advice to every Muslim.
Companions recall pledging allegiance to the Prophet under the tree, for patience or death, the Ansar for jihad at the Trench, and, migration being over, for Islam and jihad.
At Tabuk the Prophet gives Aila's king, who sent him a mule and cloak, a treaty keeping his authority; Umar urges keeping Allah's covenant with the Dhimmis, the Prophet's convention.
The Prophet honours the asylum Um Hani gave a man on the day Mecca was conquered, and Ali's paper says any Muslim's asylum binds all and declares Medina a sanctuary.
Ali says they wrote only the Quran and a paper from the Prophet: Medina is a sanctuary, even the lowest Muslim's asylum binds all, and its betrayer is cursed.
The Prophet takes the pledge of believing women by word alone, never touching their hands, against worshipping others, stealing, adultery and wailing for the dead, and men pledge likewise.
Companions pledged to listen and obey, when active or tired, as far as they could, to observe jihad while alive, and to die; Ibn Umar so pledged to Abdul Malik.
Salama pledged twice under the tree, a feverish bedouin's pledge was not cancelled, a child was blessed instead, pledging for worldly gain was condemned, and women pledged by words only.

The pledge to the Prophet bars associating partners with Allah, stealing, illegal intercourse, killing offspring, slander and disobedience; punishment in this world expiates, and screened sins rest with Allah.
